summary: Issue #1 was caused by `add` in src/add.js subtracting (`a - b`). I changed it to `a + b`; the lib test failed before (-1 !== 5) and passes after. I ask orus to open a change pull request with that fix.

actions.title: Fix add to sum its arguments instead of subtracting
actions.body:
Fixes #1.

`add(a, b)` in `src/add.js` returned `a - b`, so `add(2, 3)` gave -1. I changed the operator to `a + b`.

Before: `test/add.test.js` fails with `-1 !== 5`.
After: `node --test` (lib) passes, 1 of 1 tests.
